models.name: Fed-batch titer (example)
models.description: Synthetic fed-batch cell culture model: final titer, peak cell density and viability from feed rate, temperature, duration and seeding density.

card.question: What final titer does a fed-batch culture reach at a given feed rate, temperature, culture duration and seeding density?
card.intendedUse: Screening feed and temperature set points for the production bioreactor of the example mAb process before bench runs. Not for release decisions, and not for any real process: the numbers are invented.
card.applicability: CHO fed-batch culture of a monoclonal antibody, daily bolus feed, 2 L to 2000 L. Inputs outside the ranges above are extrapolation.
card.performance: Not validated: an example. A real card states the error of predicted against measured titer, and on which batches.
card.lineage: Logistic growth with temperature- and feed-dependent productivity; parameters chosen by hand for the example.
card.limitations: No nutrient, metabolite, pH or dissolved-oxygen effects.
